GP.name: Gauteng
GP.cultural_notes: Most urbanized and culturally diverse province. Economic pressure, fast-paced. Nyaope epidemic in townships.
GP.support_services: Abundant - multiple SANCA branches, AA/NA, private facilities

WC.name: Western Cape
WC.context: Cape colored identity, Afrikaner culture, Xhosa communities
WC.cultural_notes: Cape colored identity distinct. Tik (meth) crisis in colored communities. Gang involvement. Historic inequality (Cape Flats).
WC.support_services: Good - SANCA Western Cape, community programs, faith-based

KZN.name: KwaZulu-Natal
KZN.context: Zulu culture predominant, traditional structures strong
KZN.cultural_notes: Strong Zulu cultural identity. Traditional healing primary in rural areas. Elder respect critical. Indian/Asian community in Durban. HIV/AIDS intersection.
KZN.support_services: Moderate - SANCA Durban, traditional healers, faith communities

EC.name: Eastern Cape
EC.context: Rural, high poverty, Xhosa culture strong
EC.cultural_notes: Rural with high poverty. Xhosa traditions strong. Initiation practices (ulwaluko). High unemployment and urban migration. Infrastructure challenges.
EC.support_services: Limited - SANCA limited reach, traditional healers primary, church communities

LP.name: Limpopo
LP.context: Most rural, multiple distinct cultural groups, traditional leadership strong
LP.cultural_notes: Multiple cultural groups. Strong traditional practices. Zimbabwe/Mozambique borders. Infrastructure challenges. Traditional healing central.
LP.support_services: Very limited - traditional healers primary, community health workers

MP.name: Mpumalanga
MP.context: Mining communities, borders Mozambique and eSwatini, mix urban/rural
MP.cultural_notes: Mining communities. Migrant labor patterns. Cross-border drug trade. Tourism (Kruger). siSwati culture important but small.
MP.support_services: Limited - some services in urban areas, traditional healers

NW.name: North West
NW.context: Platinum belt mining, Tswana culture and kgotla system, rural and mining towns
NW.cultural_notes: Platinum mining communities. Tswana kgotla (community gathering) system. Traditional structures respected. Migrant labor.
NW.support_services: Limited - some services in mining areas, traditional structures

FS.name: Free State
FS.context: Agricultural, Basotho and Afrikaner communities, rural conservative
FS.cultural_notes: Farming communities. Basotho culture. Afrikaner farming areas. Rural, conservative. High unemployment. Farm worker vulnerability.
FS.support_services: Limited - church communities strong, SANCA presence limited

NC.name: Northern Cape
NC.context: Least populated, vast area, mining towns, San indigenous communities, desert
NC.cultural_notes: Least populated, largest province. Vast distances. Mining towns. San (indigenous) communities vulnerable and underserved. Geographic isolation.
NC.support_services: Very limited - vast distances, some services in Kimberley, mobile outreach needed

metadata.note: This configuration supports culturally appropriate substance abuse support across South Africa's diverse provinces
